# Lab 6.8: Attach a Least-privilege Service Account to a VM

## What We Are Going to Do
Replace the Compute Engine default service account with a dedicated account that can only read one bucket.

## Steps

1. **See the default problem.** Go to **IAM & Admin → IAM** and find `PROJECT_NUMBER-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com`. In older projects it may have the broad **Editor** role.

2. **Create a bucket and a dedicated service account.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-sa-lab --location=us-central1
echo "hello" | gcloud storage cp - gs://$PROJECT_ID-sa-lab/hello.txt

gcloud iam service-accounts create vm-reader-sa --display-name="VM bucket reader"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Grant access to that bucket only.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://$PROJECT_ID-sa-lab \
  --member=serviceAccount:vm-reader-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/storage.objectViewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a VM with that account.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create sa-lab-vm \
  --zone=us-central1-a \
  --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --service-account=vm-reader-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --scopes=cloud-platform</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test from inside the VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh sa-lab-vm --zone=us-central1-a --command="gcloud storage cat gs://$PROJECT_ID-sa-lab/hello.txt; gcloud compute instances list"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Reading the bucket works. Listing VMs fails with a permission error, which is what we want.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete sa-lab-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-sa-lab
gcloud iam service-accounts delete vm-reader-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Bucket read | Allowed |
| Listing VMs | Denied |
| Scopes | Set to `cloud-platform`, IAM decides access |
| Default SA | Avoided for production workloads |
